top_signal.title: Looking for a US 3PL recommendation: Shopify integration, multichannel (TikTok Shop, Amazon), small volume
top_signal.summary: I'm launching a new e-commerce brand in the US and I'm looking for a 3PL/warehouse recommendation. I'm based outside the US, so I'd handle everything remotely.    What I need:      Receive my imported inventory (shipping from Asia)   Store it and fulfill orders   Integration with Shopify   Also connects with TikTok Shop and Amazon (MCF or FBA prep), ideally Walmart later   Works with small volumes at the start, no huge minimums   Good dashboard and support, since I'll be managing everything online   Bonus if they can help with or recommend a customs broker for the import side      Which 3PLs have you worked with that are startup-friendly and actually reliable?  Also curious about rough pricing (receiving, storage, pick & pack) and any red flags to watch out for.    Thanks in advance!        submitted by     /u/Ashamed_Wear_7810       [link]       [comments]
